convert_tf_generator: convert a TensorFlow StyleGAN2 generator network pickle to a PyTorch Generator module
convert_tf_discriminator: convert a TensorFlow StyleGAN2 discriminator network pickle to a PyTorch Discriminator module
load_network_pkl: load a network pickle file and optionally force FP16 precision for all networks
convert_network_pickle_cli: run the CLI to convert a legacy TensorFlow network pickle to native PyTorch format
populate_module_params: populate a PyTorch module parameters by matching regex patterns against TensorFlow weights
